basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of the coveted Lake Street District, this exquisite two-bedroom, one-bath condo offers a lifestyle of unparalleled charm and convenience. Imagine stepping into a sun-drenched haven where gleaming hardwood floors flow seamlessly beneath your feet, leading you to a living room graced by the cozy embrace of a wood-burning fireplace - perfect for those crisp San Francisco evenings.    Each spacious bedroom is bathed in natural light, creating serene retreats for rest and rejuvenation.  Beyond the elegant interiors, discover your own private oasis: an amazing backyard boasting a vibrant garden and a lush green lawn - an idyllic setting for al fresco dining, morning coffee, or simply unwinding amidst nature's beauty.    Practicality meets ease with one-car tandem parking and shared laundry facilities. And the location? Simply unbeatable. With transportation options just moments away and effortless access to the iconic Golden Gate Bridge, the city is truly at your fingertips. Stroll down the charming Clement Street, where a delightful array of shops and restaurants await, promising endless opportunities for exploration and indulgence. Don't miss this exceptional opportunity!
